items.name: allies-dinosaurs
items.prompt: Production sprite atlas for the existing whimsical handcrafted miniature family tower defense La Conquete des Serpents. EXACT 2 by 2 grid of FOUR isolated complete subjects on pure white, one subject centered in EACH 1024 square quadrant of a 2048 square sheet. Every subject full body with generous 15% blank padding, never crossing quadrant boundaries. NO text, no letters, no labels, no borders, no scenery, no props outside subject. Premium storybook gouache and tactile painted clay, crisp iconic silhouette, strong clean colors, simplified readable details at 80px size. Soft consistent upper-left lighting. Ground contact at bottom of each quadrant. Side three-quarter game view. ALL FOUR creatures face LEFT and are friendly baby dinosaur ALLIES with bright teal neckerchiefs. TOP LEFT: small purple and turquoise VELOCIRAPTOR, lean legs, long horizontal tail, mischievous smile. TOP RIGHT: mint and coral TRICERATOPS, exactly three facial horns and large solid frill, chunky friendly charging posture. BOTTOM LEFT: turquoise STEGOSAURUS, distinct large orange upright dorsal plates and spiked tail. BOTTOM RIGHT: friendly orange TYRANNOSAURUS REX, huge head, tiny two arms, strong two legs, NOT dragon, no wings. Four noticeably distinct species and silhouettes, all facing left.
